children: France solutions provider's H1 2026 revenue fell 4.8% yr/yr, reflecting reduced business activity
Order intake for H1 2026 rose 23.4% yr/yr, driven by contract renewals
Linedata says it will focus on consolidating organic growth in H2 2026
CYBER INCIDENT IMPACT - Co said lower business activity reflected ongoing effects from the August 2025 cyberattack
HIGHER EXTERNAL EXPENSES - Increased consulting and IT services costs related to the cyberattack and one-off sales costs weighed on results
LOWER PERSONNEL EXPENSES - Personnel expenses fell, mainly due to restructuring measures in 2025 and increased capitalized R&D
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Linedata Services SA is €56.80, about 26.8% above its September 8 closing price of €44.80
